```{python}
import polars as pl
#import plotting modules
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
#import stats modules
from scipy.stats import chi2
from pingouin import ttest
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

#import img plotting modules
from nilearn.image import iter_img, index_img
from nilearn.plotting import plot_stat_map, show
from nibabel import load as load_nii
import numpy as np
import os

import matplotlib
from met_brewer import met_brew, is_colorblind_friendly
#set matplotlib rendering to TkAgg
matplotlib.use('TkAgg')

met_colors_name = "Hiroshige"

met_colors = met_brew(name=met_colors_name)
print(is_colorblind_friendly(met_colors_name))

sns.set_theme(style="white", palette=met_colors)

def makeswarmplot(title, x, y, hue=None):
    ax = plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
    ax = sns.stripplot(x=x, y=y, hue=hue)
    plt.title(title)
    return ax

def makeviolinplot(df_to_plot):
  plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
  ax = sns.violinplot(x=df_to_plot['value'], y=df_to_plot['cont_variable'], hue=df_to_plot['value'],  inner=None)
  ax = sns.stripplot(x=df_to_plot['value'], y=df_to_plot['cont_variable'],  dodge=True, color='black', alpha=0.3)
  return ax

def get_threshold(img, threshold=90):
      data = img.get_fdata().flatten()
      data = data[data != 0]
      return np.percentile(data,threshold)

def plot_stat_map_with_threshold(img, title, coord_cut, output_file, bg_img=bg_img, threshold=90):
    thresh_value = get_threshold(img, threshold)
    plot_stat_map(
        img,
        bg_img=bg_img,
        title=title,
        display_mode='y',
        cut_coords=[coord_cut],
        threshold=thresh_value,
        vmin=0,
        colorbar=False,
        black_bg=False,
        output_file=output_file
    )

def get_dr_map(scan, data_dir, analysis, dr_index):
    dr_dice_dir= "commonspace_analysis_datasink/dual_regression_nii"
    dr_map_path = os.path.join(data_dir, analysis,dr_dice_dir, f"_split_name_{scan}_task-rest_bold", f"{scan}_task-rest_bold_cleaned_DR_maps.nii.gz")
    if os.path.isfile(dr_map_path): 
      return index_img(dr_map_path, dr_index)
    else: 
      print(f"DR map not found for scan {scan} at {dr_map_path}")
      return None


pl.Config(
    tbl_formatting="MARKDOWN",
    tbl_hide_column_data_types=True,
    tbl_hide_dataframe_shape=True,
    tbl_rows=100,
)

analysis_list = [ "gsr1", "gsr2", "gsr3","wmcsf1", "wmcsf2", "wmcsf3", "aCompCor1", "aCompCor2", "aCompCor3" ]  

roi_list=["s1","thal"]

```

  print("do dice statistical analysis for s1")
  cols = [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith(f"dr{dr_s1}")]
  df_dice = df.select(["scan", *cols]).unpivot(index=["scan"], on=cols).drop_nulls().to_pandas()
  
  # Fit linear mixed model and reduced model
  full_model= smf.mixedlm("value ~ variable", df_dice, groups="scan").fit()
  print(full_model.summary())

  reduced_model = smf.mixedlm("value ~ 1", data=df_dice, groups="scan").fit()
 
  # carry out likelyhood test ratio
  lr_stat = 2 * (full_model.llf - reduced_model.llf)
  df_diff = full_model.df_modelwc - reduced_model.df_modelwc

  p_value = chi2.sf(lr_stat, df_diff)

  print(f"LR statistic: {lr_stat}, df: {df_diff}, p-value: {p_value}")
  
  plt.figure(figsize=(10,10))
  ax = sns.ecdfplot(data=df_dice, x="value", hue="variable")

  print("analysis of dice in s1 as a function of mean framewise displacement")
  df = df.with_columns(pl.col("fd.mean").alias("fd_mean"), pl.col("fd.max").alias("fd_max"))

  full_model = smf.ols("dice_s1 ~ fd_mean", data=df).fit()
  reduced_model = smf.ols("dice_s1 ~ 1", data=df).fit()

  lr_stat = 2 * (full_model.llf - reduced_model.llf)
  df_diff = full_model.df_model - reduced_model.df_model
  p_value = chi2.sf(lr_stat, df_diff)
  print(f"LR statistic: {lr_stat}, df: {df_diff}, p-value: {p_value}")

  plt.figure(figsize=(10,10))
  ax = sns.scatterplot(x=df["fd_mean"], y=df["dice_s1"])
  ax.figure.savefig("../assets/plot/"+rodent+"_dice_s1_vs_fd_mean.svg")

  full_model = smf.ols("dice_s1 ~ fd_max", data=df).fit()
  reduced_model = smf.ols("dice_s1 ~ 1", data=df).fit()

  lr_stat = 2 * (full_model.llf - reduced_model.llf)
  df_diff = full_model.df_model - reduced_model.df_model
  p_value = chi2.sf(lr_stat, df_diff)
  print(f"LR statistic: {lr_stat}, df: {df_diff}, p-value: {p_value}")

  plt.figure(figsize=(10,10))
  ax = sns.scatterplot(x=df["fd_max"], y=df["dice_s1"])
  ax.figure.savefig("../assets/plot/"+rodent+"_dice_s1_vs_fd_max.svg")


  print("analysis of dice in aca as a function of mean framewise displacement")
  full_model = smf.ols("dice_aca ~ fd_mean", data=df).fit()
  reduced_model = smf.ols("dice_aca ~ 1", data=df).fit()

  lr_stat = 2 * (full_model.llf - reduced_model.llf)
  df_diff = full_model.df_model - reduced_model.df_model
  p_value = chi2.sf(lr_stat, df_diff)
  print(f"LR statistic: {lr_stat}, df: {df_diff}, p-value: {p_value}")

  plt.figure(figsize=(10,10))
  ax = sns.scatterplot(x=df["fd_mean"], y=df["dice_aca"])
  ax.figure.savefig("../assets/plot/"+rodent+"_dice_aca_vs_fd_mean.svg")

  full_model = smf.ols("dice_aca ~ fd_max", data=df).fit()
  reduced_model = smf.ols("dice_aca ~ 1", data=df).fit()

  lr_stat = 2 * (full_model.llf - reduced_model.llf)
  df_diff = full_model.df_model - reduced_model.df_model
  p_value = chi2.sf(lr_stat, df_diff)
  print(f"LR statistic: {lr_stat}, df: {df_diff}, p-value: {p_value}")

  plt.figure(figsize=(10,10))
  ax = sns.scatterplot(x=df["fd_max"], y=df["dice_aca"])
  ax.figure.savefig("../assets/plot/"+rodent+"_dice_aca_vs_fd_max.svg")

  print("plot the dictionary components, not used in the  analysis")
  for i, cur_img in enumerate(iter_img(dict_img)):
    plot_stat_map(
        cur_img,
        bg_img=bg_img,
        title=f"IC {int(i)}",
        threshold=0.03,
        vmax=0.1,
        vmin=-0.1,
        colorbar=False,
        black_bg=False,
        output_file=f"../assets/plot/dict/{rodent}_dict_{analysis}_IC{int(i)}.svg"
    )
  
  print("plotting the reference ica for dice analysis")
  #plot reference ica used for dice analysis
  plot_stat_map_with_threshold(index_img(ica_img,dr_s1), f"ICA S1",dr_s1_cut, f"../assets/plot/dice/{rodent}_s1_ref.svg")
  plot_stat_map_with_threshold(index_img(ica_img,dr_aca), f"ICA ACA",dr_aca_cut, f"../assets/plot/dice/{rodent}_aca_ref.svg")


  print("plotting the top, median and low dice images for s1")
  df_sorted = df.select(["scan", "dice_s1"]).sort(by="dice_s1", descending=True).drop_nulls()
  
  print("outup top dice image for s1")
  scan_to_plot = df_sorted[0]
  i = get_dr_map(scan_to_plot["scan"][0], data_dir, analysis, dr_s1)
  d = round(scan_to_plot["dice_s1"][0],2)
  plot_stat_map_with_threshold(i, f"Dice top: {d}",dr_s1_cut, f"../assets/plot/dice/{rodent}_s1_top.svg")

  print("output median dice image for s1")
  scan_to_plot = df_sorted[len(df_sorted)//2]
  i = get_dr_map(scan_to_plot["scan"][0], data_dir, analysis, dr_s1)
  d = round(scan_to_plot["dice_s1"][0],2)
  plot_stat_map_with_threshold(i, f"Dice median: {d}",dr_s1_cut, f"../assets/plot/dice/{rodent}_s1_med.svg")

  print("output low dice image for s1")
  scan_to_plot = df_sorted[len(df_sorted)-1]
  i = get_dr_map(scan_to_plot["scan"][0], data_dir, analysis, dr_s1)
  d = round(scan_to_plot["dice_s1"][0],2)
  plot_stat_map_with_threshold(i, f"Dice low: {d}",dr_s1_cut, f"../assets/plot/dice/{rodent}_s1_low.svg")

  print("plotting the top, median and low dice images for aca")
  df_sorted = df.select(["scan", "dice_aca"]).sort(by="dice_aca", descending=True).drop_nulls()
  
  print("outup top dice image for aca")
  scan_to_plot = df_sorted[0]
  i = get_dr_map(scan_to_plot["scan"][0], data_dir, analysis, dr_s1)
  d = round(scan_to_plot["dice_aca"][0],2)
  plot_stat_map_with_threshold(i, f"Dice top: {d}",dr_aca_cut, f"../assets/plot/dice/{rodent}_aca_top.svg")

  print("output median dice image for aca")
  scan_to_plot = df_sorted[len(df_sorted)//2]
  i = get_dr_map(scan_to_plot["scan"][0], data_dir, analysis, dr_aca)
  d = round(scan_to_plot["dice_aca"][0],2)
  plot_stat_map_with_threshold(i, f"Dice median: {d}",dr_aca_cut, f"../assets/plot/dice/{rodent}_aca_med.svg")

  print("output low dice image for aca")
  scan_to_plot = df_sorted[len(df_sorted)-1]
  i = get_dr_map(scan_to_plot["scan"][0], data_dir, analysis, dr_aca)
  d = round(scan_to_plot["dice_aca"][0],2)
  plot_stat_map_with_threshold(i, f"Dice low: {d}",dr_aca_cut, f"../assets/plot/dice/{rodent}_aca_low.svg")
